package_subtitle: Survey-selected arm, hand, and comfortable-walking observations matched to current ability

tasks.title: Seated Forward Reach
tasks.focus: Reach distance, elbow extension, movement quality, trunk compensation

steps.voice: Welcome. Sit upright with your affected hand on your lap. Slowly lift that hand forward to the first circle.
steps.caption: Initiate the forward reach

failure_phenotype.label: Difficulty initiating a forward reach
failure_phenotype.description: The affected arm did not complete the initial movement away from the lap toward the first reach position.

steps.voice: Now, slowly reach your affected arm forward, as far as you comfortably can, toward the bright circle in front of you. Keep your back straight and stay relaxed.
steps.caption: Reach the target, then keep your hand there. Do not lower it until asked.

failure_phenotype.label: Limited forward reach
failure_phenotype.description: The affected arm initiated the movement but did not reach the forward target.

steps.voice: Hold your hand steadily at the forward target for a moment.
steps.caption: Hold the reach steadily

failure_phenotype.label: Unstable control at the reach target
failure_phenotype.description: The affected arm reached the forward area but did not remain stable at the endpoint.

steps.voice: Wonderful effort. Slowly bring your affected hand back to your lap.
steps.caption: Return to lap

failure_phenotype.label: Difficulty controlling the return from a reach
failure_phenotype.description: The affected arm did not complete the controlled return from the forward target to the lap.

tasks.title: Hand to Mouth
tasks.focus: Hand-to-mouth function, coordination, movement quality, trunk compensation

steps.voice: Let's bring your affected hand toward your mouth. First, lift it from your lap toward the circle at your chest.
steps.caption: Lift hand from lap toward chest

failure_phenotype.label: Difficulty initiating the hand lift
failure_phenotype.description: The affected hand did not complete the initial lift from the lap toward the chest.

steps.voice: Now, slowly bring your hand up to your mouth, as if you were drinking from a cup. Keep your head still.
steps.caption: Hand to mouth

failure_phenotype.label: Difficulty bringing the hand to the mouth
failure_phenotype.description: The affected hand lifted from the lap but did not reach the mouth target.

steps.voice: Hold your affected hand steadily at your mouth for a moment.
steps.caption: Hold hand steadily at mouth

failure_phenotype.label: Unstable hand-to-mouth endpoint control
failure_phenotype.description: The affected hand reached the mouth area but did not remain stable there.

steps.voice: Great job. Lower your affected hand back to your lap.
steps.caption: Return to lap

failure_phenotype.label: Difficulty returning the hand from the mouth
failure_phenotype.description: The affected hand did not complete the controlled return from the mouth to the lap.

tasks.title: Open and Close Hand
tasks.focus: Repeated opening, closing, timing, and control

steps.voice: Open your hand wide and show your palm to the camera.
steps.caption: Open hand

failure_phenotype.label: Difficulty opening the hand
failure_phenotype.description: The hand did not reach the requested open posture.

steps.voice: Now close your hand gently, then open it again. Move slowly and smoothly.
steps.caption: Close and open smoothly

failure_phenotype.label: Impaired repeated hand opening and closing
failure_phenotype.description: The hand did not complete a controlled close-open cycle.

steps.voice: Well done. Lower your affected hand to the same place on your lap.
steps.caption: Return hand to the calibrated lap position

failure_phenotype.label: Difficulty lowering the hand to rest
failure_phenotype.description: The affected hand did not return to the resting position.

tasks.title: Thumb-Index Pinch
tasks.focus: Thumb-index opposition, pinch accuracy, pinch stability

steps.voice: Bring your hand up in front of your chest, palm facing you or the camera.
steps.caption: Hand ready for pinch

failure_phenotype.label: Difficulty positioning the hand for pinch
failure_phenotype.description: The affected hand did not reach the working position for pinch.

steps.voice: Touch the tip of your thumb to the tip of your index finger, as if pinching a small coin. Hold it steady.
steps.caption: Pinch thumb and index finger

failure_phenotype.label: Difficulty forming thumb-index pinch
failure_phenotype.description: Thumb-index opposition did not reach the requested pinch configuration.
failure_phenotype.source: ARAT pinch subscale; Fugl-Meyer UE hand section

steps.voice: Separate your fingers, then lower your affected hand to the same place on your lap.
steps.caption: Return hand to the calibrated lap position

failure_phenotype.label: Difficulty releasing pinch
failure_phenotype.description: The thumb and index finger did not separate after the pinch.

tasks.title: Comfortable Walk
tasks.focus: Patient-reported mobility with an uploaded frontal walking record
tasks.safety_note: Only attempt this task if walking is already part of your usual routine. Use your normal walking aid and have another person nearby if you normally need support.
filming_guidance: Record a short frontal video with the patient walking toward the camera at their usual comfortable pace.
Keep the patient's whole body and usual walking aid visible when possible.
A fixed camera is best. If the route does not fit, move smoothly from a safe position beside the path; do not walk backward in front of the patient.
The video is saved as an assessment record. Any lower-limb score comes only from measurable evidence in this assessment task; the affected area and side come from the patient's survey.

steps.voice: For this final walking record, ask a carer or family member to take a short video from the front while you walk toward the camera at your usual comfortable pace. Keep your whole body and usual walking aid visible when possible. A fixed camera is best. If the route does not fit, the recorder may move smoothly from a safe position beside the path, but must not walk backward in front of you.
steps.caption: Upload a short frontal walking video

failure_phenotype.label: Unable to establish a safe walking start
failure_phenotype.description: A safe, fully visible standing position was not established before the walking observation.
failure_phenotype.source: Observational gait analysis; task-specific safety screening

steps.voice: Walk toward the camera at your usual comfortable pace for a few natural steps. Do not walk faster or farther than feels safe.
steps.caption: Walk naturally toward the camera

failure_phenotype.label: Difficulty progressing during walking
failure_phenotype.description: The patient did not complete several observable steps across the camera view at a comfortable pace.

steps.voice: Stop in a safe position. The short frontal walking video is ready to upload.
steps.caption: Stop safely and stand steady

failure_phenotype.label: Difficulty stopping safely after walking
failure_phenotype.description: The patient did not establish a stable supported stop after the walking observation.
failure_phenotype.source: Observational gait analysis; task-specific safety screening
